issues.extracted: Taxes 442,438 (p5) split into property tax 320,618 / sales tax 121,820
issues.on_page: p5 Taxes 442,438; p9 (All Funds budgetary statement) General taxes 320,618 + Sales tax 121,820
issues.issue: The split uses the budgetary All Funds statement (p9), not the governmental statement itself. It also treats all of 'General taxes' as property tax, but Swimming Pool (100,000, p16), Cemetery (650, p17) and Library (73,985, p21) are printed only as 'Taxes'. The amounts add up (320,618 + 121,820 = 442,438); the split is defensible but rests on assumptions

The fund schedules show this printed line includes motor vehicle taxes/fees of 43,631 (General 3,509 p10, Street 3,082 + 9,486 p12, Sales Tax 27,554 p15), in-lieu of tax of 6,762 and occupation tax of 93. The category matches the label and the rules don't allow a split, but motor vehicle tax is understated at the receipts level

issues.on_page: Grant proceeds 200,000 (Community Ambulance; p2 shows it as Grants and Contributions, Public Safety)
issues.issue: The grant's source isn't stated, so it could be a private contribution rather than state aid; already flagged for review

issues.on_page: Licenses, fees, and permits 27,611 (26,733 of it in the Community Ambulance Fund, p18)
issues.issue: Most of this is in the ambulance fund and is probably ambulance run fees (charges for services / ambulance/rescue fees). It follows the label but is questionable. The same applies to detail[93]

14% of governmental receipts is in 'other'. The schedules identify part of it: rent 9,060, insurance refund 191 and payroll reimbursements 272 (p10), Library reimbursements 36,728 and concessions 96 (p21). The largest piece (ambulance miscellaneous 100,775, p18) is itself unexplained. Kept as printed, with review

issues.on_page: Fund balances beginning (249,650); Reclassification (127,853); restated beginning (377,503)
issues.issue: The extractor used the restated beginning balance and did not record the (127,853) Swimming Pool reclassification as an adjustment. The identity holds either way; this is an assumption the extractor made

issues.on_page: Debt principal payments - line of credit (60,000), long-term debt (180,000), Debt interest payments (59,248)
issues.issue: The arithmetic is correct and marked computed. However, debt principal and interest are kept out of disbursements, while the detail (Debt Service Fund p14: bond retirement 180,000, interest 55,713, agent fees 400) records them as expenditures. This follows each page as printed and is noted
